title: 런크크 이벤트 현황
description: 이벤트별 응모자, 코치별 대결과 승리, 포인트 지급, 일별 추이. 운영과 develop DB를 읽기 전용 계정 runkk_grafana_ro로 읽는다(infra/README.md 6절).

list.name: event
list.label: 이벤트
list.definition: SELECT id AS __value, title || ' (' || slug || ')' AS __text FROM event ORDER BY sort_order, id
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, title || ' (' || slug || ')' AS __text FROM event ORDER BY sort_order, id

list.name: tzfix
list.label: 시각 보정
list.query: 자동(V48 여부) : auto, 보정 없음 : 0, 9시간 빼기 : 9
list.description: 운영 DB는 2차 배포(V48) 전까지 서버가 쓴 시각이 9시간 앞서 저장된다. 자동은 V48이 없는 DB만 9시간 빼서 보여 준다

panels.title: 코치 대결 응모자
panels.description: 선택한 코치 대결 이벤트(COACH_CELEB)의 응모자 수 합. 이벤트 셀럽 기록을 기간 안(양 끝 포함)에 한 번 이상 이긴 회원이고 탈퇴 회원은 뺀다(EventEntrantService와 같은 판정). 시각은 저장 값끼리 비교해 세므로 보정과 관계없다. 보정은 화면에 보이는 시각과 날짜에만 쓴다(위쪽 「시각 보정」).

targets.rawSql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.id, e.slug, e.title, e.kind, e.published, e.sort_order, e.starts_at, e.ends_at, e.config::jsonb AS cfg
  FROM event e
  WHERE e.id IN ($event)
),
coach_win AS (
  -- 셀럽마다 첫 승리(BattleRepository.findCelebrityWinners): 끝난 셀럽 대결, 회원 승리, 판정 시각이 기간 안(양 끝 포함)
  SELECT ev.id AS event_id, b.winner_member_id AS member_id, b.opponent_record_id AS celebrity_id, min(b.judged_at) AS won_at
  FROM ev
  JOIN battle b
    ON b.status = 'FINISHED' AND b.type = 'CELEBRITY' AND b.opponent_kind = 'CELEBRITY'
   AND b.winner_member_id IS NOT NULL
   AND b.opponent_record_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(ev.cfg -> 'celebrityIds'))
   AND b.judged_at BETWEEN ev.starts_at AND ev.ends_at
  WHERE ev.kind = 'COACH_CELEB'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
run_first AS (
  -- 기준 거리 이상인 첫 유효 기록(RunQueryService.earliestValidRunsAtLeast): 시작 시각이 기간 안(양 끝 포함)
  SELECT ev.id AS event_id, r.member_id, min(r.started_at) AS run_at
  FROM ev
  JOIN run_record r
    ON r.valid AND r.distance_meters >= CAST(ev.cfg ->> 'minDistanceMeters' AS bigint)
   AND r.started_at BETWEEN ev.starts_at AND ev.ends_at
  WHERE ev.kind = 'RUN_DISTANCE'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
entrant AS (
  -- 탈퇴 회원 제외(MemberQueryService.activeNicknames: ACTIVE이고 닉네임이 있는 회원만)
  SELECT x.event_id, x.member_id, m.nickname, x.items, x.first_at
  FROM (SELECT event_id, member_id, count(*) AS items, min(won_at) AS first_at FROM coach_win GROUP BY 1, 2
        UNION ALL
        SELECT event_id, member_id, 1, run_at FROM run_first) x
  JOIN member m ON m.id = x.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.nickname IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT count(*) AS "코치 대결 응모자"
FROM entrant en JOIN ev ON ev.id = en.event_id
WHERE ev.kind = 'COACH_CELEB'

panels.title: 이벤트 포인트 지급
panels.description: 선택한 이벤트의 포인트 지급 이력(event_point_grant) 건수와 합계. 지급은 이미 일어난 일이라 탈퇴 회원 몫도 센다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.id, e.slug, e.title, e.kind, e.published, e.sort_order, e.starts_at, e.ends_at, e.config::jsonb AS cfg
  FROM event e
  WHERE e.id IN ($event)
),
grant_sum AS (
  SELECT g.event_id, count(*) AS grants, sum(g.amount) AS amount
  FROM event_point_grant g JOIN ev ON ev.id = g.event_id
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT coalesce(sum(grants), 0) AS "지급 건수", coalesce(sum(amount), 0) AS "지급 합계"
FROM grant_sum

panels.title: 이벤트별 현황
panels.description: 이벤트마다 응모자 수와 포인트 지급. 상태와 시작, 끝은 「시각 보정」을 적용한 한국 시각이다. 비공개 이벤트도 보인다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cfg AS (
  -- 표시 보정 시간: 자동이면 서버 시간대 수정 V48이 없는 DB(운영 2차 배포 전)만 9시간 뺀다
  -- 숫자가 아닌 값(auto)은 NULL이 되어 자동 판정으로 간다
  SELECT coalesce(CAST(NULLIF(regexp_replace('${tzfix}', '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS integer),
                  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flyway_schema_history WHERE version = '48' AND success) THEN 0 ELSE 9 END) AS shift_hours
),
ev AS (
  SELECT e.id, e.slug, e.title, e.kind, e.published, e.sort_order, e.starts_at, e.ends_at, e.config::jsonb AS cfg
  FROM event e
  WHERE e.id IN ($event)
),
coach_win AS (
  -- 셀럽마다 첫 승리(BattleRepository.findCelebrityWinners): 끝난 셀럽 대결, 회원 승리, 판정 시각이 기간 안(양 끝 포함)
  SELECT ev.id AS event_id, b.winner_member_id AS member_id, b.opponent_record_id AS celebrity_id, min(b.judged_at) AS won_at
  FROM ev
  JOIN battle b
    ON b.status = 'FINISHED' AND b.type = 'CELEBRITY' AND b.opponent_kind = 'CELEBRITY'
   AND b.winner_member_id IS NOT NULL
   AND b.opponent_record_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(ev.cfg -> 'celebrityIds'))
   AND b.judged_at BETWEEN ev.starts_at AND ev.ends_at
  WHERE ev.kind = 'COACH_CELEB'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
run_first AS (
  -- 기준 거리 이상인 첫 유효 기록(RunQueryService.earliestValidRunsAtLeast): 시작 시각이 기간 안(양 끝 포함)
  SELECT ev.id AS event_id, r.member_id, min(r.started_at) AS run_at
  FROM ev
  JOIN run_record r
    ON r.valid AND r.distance_meters >= CAST(ev.cfg ->> 'minDistanceMeters' AS bigint)
   AND r.started_at BETWEEN ev.starts_at AND ev.ends_at
  WHERE ev.kind = 'RUN_DISTANCE'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
entrant AS (
  -- 탈퇴 회원 제외(MemberQueryService.activeNicknames: ACTIVE이고 닉네임이 있는 회원만)
  SELECT x.event_id, x.member_id, m.nickname, x.items, x.first_at
  FROM (SELECT event_id, member_id, count(*) AS items, min(won_at) AS first_at FROM coach_win GROUP BY 1, 2
        UNION ALL
        SELECT event_id, member_id, 1, run_at FROM run_first) x
  JOIN member m ON m.id = x.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.nickname IS NOT NULL
),
grant_sum AS (
  SELECT g.event_id, count(*) AS grants, sum(g.amount) AS amount
  FROM event_point_grant g JOIN ev ON ev.id = g.event_id
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ev.title AS "이벤트",
       ev.slug AS "slug",
       CASE ev.kind WHEN 'COACH_CELEB' THEN '코치 대결' ELSE '거리 ' || CAST(trim_scale(CAST(ev.cfg ->> 'minDistanceMeters' AS numeric) / 1000) AS text) || 'km' END AS "종류",
       CASE WHEN ev.published THEN '공개' ELSE '비공개' END AS "공개",
       CASE WHEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') + make_interval(hours => cfg.shift_hours) < ev.starts_at THEN '예정'
            WHEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') + make_interval(hours => cfg.shift_hours) > ev.ends_at THEN '종료'
            ELSE '진행 중' END AS "상태",
       to_char(ev.starts_at - make_interval(hours => cfg.shift_hours), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "시작",
       to_char(ev.ends_at - make_interval(hours => cfg.shift_hours), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "끝",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM entrant en WHERE en.event_id = ev.id) AS "응모자",
       coalesce(gs.grants, 0) AS "포인트 지급 건수",
       coalesce(gs.amount, 0) AS "포인트 지급 합계"
FROM ev CROSS JOIN cfg
LEFT JOIN grant_sum gs ON gs.event_id = ev.id
ORDER BY ev.sort_order, ev.id

panels.title: 코치별 대결과 승리
panels.description: 코치 대결 이벤트의 셀럽(코치) 기록마다 기간 안 끝난 대결 수, 회원이 이긴 대결 수, 첫 승리 회원 수(응모 항목 달성, 탈퇴 제외), 포인트 지급. 대결과 승리는 같은 회원이 여러 번 해도 모두 센다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.id, e.slug, e.title, e.kind, e.published, e.sort_order, e.starts_at, e.ends_at, e.config::jsonb AS cfg

   AND b.winner_member_id IS NOT NULL
   AND b.opponent_record_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(ev.cfg -> 'celebrityIds'))
   AND b.judged_at BETWEEN ev.starts_at AND ev.ends_at
  WHERE ev.kind = 'COACH_CELEB'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
run_first AS (
  -- 기준 거리 이상인 첫 유효 기록(RunQueryService.earliestValidRunsAtLeast): 시작 시각이 기간 안(양 끝 포함)
  SELECT ev.id AS event_id, r.member_id, min(r.started_at) AS run_at
  FROM ev
  JOIN run_record r
    ON r.valid AND r.distance_meters >= CAST(ev.cfg ->> 'minDistanceMeters' AS bigint)
   AND r.started_at BETWEEN ev.starts_at AND ev.ends_at
  WHERE ev.kind = 'RUN_DISTANCE'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
entrant AS (
  -- 탈퇴 회원 제외(MemberQueryService.activeNicknames: ACTIVE이고 닉네임이 있는 회원만)
  SELECT x.event_id, x.member_id, m.nickname, x.items, x.first_at
  FROM (SELECT event_id, member_id, count(*) AS items, min(won_at) AS first_at FROM coach_win GROUP BY 1, 2
        UNION ALL
        SELECT event_id, member_id, 1, run_at FROM run_first) x
  JOIN member m ON m.id = x.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.nickname IS NOT NULL
)
, celeb AS (
  SELECT ev.id AS event_id, ev.title, ev.sort_order, ev.starts_at, ev.ends_at, c.celebrity_id, c.ord
  FROM ev, jsonb_array_elements_text(ev.cfg -> 'celebrityIds') WITH ORDINALITY AS c(celebrity_id, ord)
  WHERE ev.kind = 'COACH_CELEB'
)
SELECT celeb.title AS "이벤트",
       coalesce(cr.anonymous_name, '셀럽 ' || celeb.celebrity_id) AS "코치",
       celeb.celebrity_id AS "기록 ID",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM battle b
         WHERE b.status = 'FINISHED' AND b.type = 'CELEBRITY' AND b.opponent_kind = 'CELEBRITY'
           AND b.opponent_record_id = celeb.celebrity_id AND b.judged_at BETWEEN celeb.starts_at AND celeb.ends_at) AS "대결",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM battle b
         WHERE b.status = 'FINISHED' AND b.type = 'CELEBRITY' AND b.opponent_kind = 'CELEBRITY' AND b.winner_member_id IS NOT NULL
           AND b.opponent_record_id = celeb.celebrity_id AND b.judged_at BETWEEN celeb.starts_at AND celeb.ends_at) AS "회원 승리",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM coach_win cw JOIN member m ON m.id = cw.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.nickname IS NOT NULL
         WHERE cw.event_id = celeb.event_id AND cw.celebrity_id = celeb.celebrity_id) AS "응모자(첫 승리)",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM event_point_grant g
         WHERE g.event_id = celeb.event_id AND g.target_key = 'celebrity-' || celeb.celebrity_id) AS "포인트 지급 건수",
       (SELECT coalesce(sum(g.amount), 0) FROM event_point_grant g
         WHERE g.event_id = celeb.event_id AND g.target_key = 'celebrity-' || celeb.celebrity_id) AS "포인트 지급 합계"
FROM celeb
LEFT JOIN celebrity_record cr ON CAST(cr.id AS text) = celeb.celebrity_id
ORDER BY celeb.sort_order, celeb.event_id, celeb.ord

  FROM event e
  WHERE e.id IN ($event)

   AND b.winner_member_id IS NOT NULL
   AND b.opponent_record_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(ev.cfg -> 'celebrityIds'))
   AND b.judged_at BETWEEN ev.starts_at AND ev.ends_at
  WHERE ev.kind = 'COACH_CELEB'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
run_first AS (
  -- 기준 거리 이상인 첫 유효 기록(RunQueryService.earliestValidRunsAtLeast): 시작 시각이 기간 안(양 끝 포함)
  SELECT ev.id AS event_id, r.member_id, min(r.started_at) AS run_at
  FROM ev
  JOIN run_record r
    ON r.valid AND r.distance_meters >= CAST(ev.cfg ->> 'minDistanceMeters' AS bigint)
   AND r.started_at BETWEEN ev.starts_at AND ev.ends_at
  WHERE ev.kind = 'RUN_DISTANCE'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
entrant AS (
  -- 탈퇴 회원 제외(MemberQueryService.activeNicknames: ACTIVE이고 닉네임이 있는 회원만)
  SELECT x.event_id, x.member_id, m.nickname, x.items, x.first_at
  FROM (SELECT event_id, member_id, count(*) AS items, min(won_at) AS first_at FROM coach_win GROUP BY 1, 2
        UNION ALL
        SELECT event_id, member_id, 1, run_at FROM run_first) x
  JOIN member m ON m.id = x.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.nickname IS NOT NULL
),
days AS (
  -- 이벤트 기간의 날짜(표시 보정 뒤 한국 날짜), 오늘까지만
  SELECT ev.id AS event_id, ev.title, CAST(d AS date) AS day, d AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS t
  FROM ev CROSS JOIN cfg,
       generate_series(date_trunc('day', ev.starts_at - make_interval(hours => cfg.shift_hours)),
                       date_trunc('day', least(ev.ends_at - make_interval(hours => cfg.shift_hours), now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')),

)
SELECT days.t AS "time",
       days.title AS metric,
       count(en.member_id) AS value
FROM days CROSS JOIN cfg
LEFT JOIN entrant en
  ON en.event_id = days.event_id AND CAST(en.first_at - make_interval(hours => cfg.shift_hours) AS date) = days.day
WHERE $__timeFilter(days.t)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: 일별 코치 대결과 승리
panels.description: 선택한 코치 대결 이벤트 셀럽 기록과의 끝난 대결 수와 회원 승리 수(판정 날짜 기준, 한국 날짜).

),
ev AS (
  SELECT e.id, e.slug, e.title, e.kind, e.published, e.sort_order, e.starts_at, e.ends_at, e.config::jsonb AS cfg
  FROM event e
  WHERE e.id IN ($event)
),
days AS (
  -- 이벤트 기간의 날짜(표시 보정 뒤 한국 날짜), 오늘까지만
  SELECT ev.id AS event_id, ev.title, CAST(d AS date) AS day, d AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS t
  FROM ev CROSS JOIN cfg,
       generate_series(date_trunc('day', ev.starts_at - make_interval(hours => cfg.shift_hours)),
                       date_trunc('day', least(ev.ends_at - make_interval(hours => cfg.shift_hours), now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')),
                       interval '1 day') AS d
)
, coach_days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT days.day, days.t FROM days JOIN ev ON ev.id = days.event_id WHERE ev.kind = 'COACH_CELEB'
),
coach_battle AS (
  -- 선택한 코치 이벤트의 셀럽 대결(기간 안, 끝난 대결). 두 이벤트가 같은 대결을 세지 않게 대결마다 한 번
  SELECT DISTINCT b.id, b.judged_at, b.winner_member_id
  FROM ev
  JOIN battle b
    ON b.status = 'FINISHED' AND b.type = 'CELEBRITY' AND b.opponent_kind = 'CELEBRITY'
   AND b.opponent_record_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(ev.cfg -> 'celebrityIds'))
   AND b.judged_at BETWEEN ev.starts_at AND ev.ends_at
  WHERE ev.kind = 'COACH_CELEB'
)
SELECT cd.t AS "time",
       count(cb.id) AS "대결",
       count(cb.winner_member_id) AS "회원 승리"
FROM coach_days cd CROSS JOIN cfg
LEFT JOIN coach_battle cb ON CAST(cb.judged_at - make_interval(hours => cfg.shift_hours) AS date) = cd.day
WHERE $__timeFilter(cd.t)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 일별 이벤트 포인트 지급
panels.description: 그날 지급한 이벤트 포인트 건수(막대)와 합계(오른쪽 축). 지급 시각 기준 한국 날짜.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cfg AS (
  -- 표시 보정 시간: 자동이면 서버 시간대 수정 V48이 없는 DB(운영 2차 배포 전)만 9시간 뺀다
  -- 숫자가 아닌 값(auto)은 NULL이 되어 자동 판정으로 간다
  SELECT coalesce(CAST(NULLIF(regexp_replace('${tzfix}', '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS integer),
                  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flyway_schema_history WHERE version = '48' AND success) THEN 0 ELSE 9 END) AS shift_hours
),
ev AS (
  SELECT e.id, e.slug, e.title, e.kind, e.published, e.sort_order, e.starts_at, e.ends_at, e.config::jsonb AS cfg
  FROM event e
  WHERE e.id IN ($event)
),
days AS (
  -- 이벤트 기간의 날짜(표시 보정 뒤 한국 날짜), 오늘까지만
  SELECT ev.id AS event_id, ev.title, CAST(d AS date) AS day, d AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS t
  FROM ev CROSS JOIN cfg,
       generate_series(date_trunc('day', ev.starts_at - make_interval(hours => cfg.shift_hours)),
                       date_trunc('day', least(ev.ends_at - make_interval(hours => cfg.shift_hours), now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')),
                       interval '1 day') AS d
)
, grant_days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT days.day, days.t FROM days JOIN ev ON ev.id = days.event_id WHERE ev.kind = 'COACH_CELEB'
)
SELECT gd.t AS "time",
       count(g.id) AS "지급 건수",
       coalesce(sum(g.amount), 0) AS "지급 합계"
FROM grant_days gd CROSS JOIN cfg
LEFT JOIN (SELECT g.* FROM event_point_grant g JOIN ev ON ev.id = g.event_id) g
  ON CAST(g.granted_at - make_interval(hours => cfg.shift_hours) AS date) = gd.day
WHERE $__timeFilter(gd.t)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 응모자 명단
panels.description: 응모자 닉네임과 달성 항목 수, 첫 응모 시각(「시각 보정」 적용). 개인정보는 닉네임까지만 보인다. 추첨 명단의 원본은 관리 API(응모자 명단)다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cfg AS (
  -- 표시 보정 시간: 자동이면 서버 시간대 수정 V48이 없는 DB(운영 2차 배포 전)만 9시간 뺀다
  -- 숫자가 아닌 값(auto)은 NULL이 되어 자동 판정으로 간다
  SELECT coalesce(CAST(NULLIF(regexp_replace('${tzfix}', '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS integer),
                  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flyway_schema_history WHERE version = '48' AND success) THEN 0 ELSE 9 END) AS shift_hours
),
ev AS (
  SELECT e.id, e.slug, e.title, e.kind, e.published, e.sort_order, e.starts_at, e.ends_at, e.config::jsonb AS cfg
  FROM event e
  WHERE e.id IN ($event)
),
coach_win AS (
  -- 셀럽마다 첫 승리(BattleRepository.findCelebrityWinners): 끝난 셀럽 대결, 회원 승리, 판정 시각이 기간 안(양 끝 포함)
  SELECT ev.id AS event_id, b.winner_member_id AS member_id, b.opponent_record_id AS celebrity_id, min(b.judged_at) AS won_at
  FROM ev
  JOIN battle b
    ON b.status = 'FINISHED' AND b.type = 'CELEBRITY' AND b.opponent_kind = 'CELEBRITY'
   AND b.winner_member_id IS NOT NULL
   AND b.opponent_record_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(ev.cfg -> 'celebrityIds'))
   AND b.judged_at BETWEEN ev.starts_at AND ev.ends_at
  WHERE ev.kind = 'COACH_CELEB'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
run_first AS (
  -- 기준 거리 이상인 첫 유효 기록(RunQueryService.earliestValidRunsAtLeast): 시작 시각이 기간 안(양 끝 포함)
  SELECT ev.id AS event_id, r.member_id, min(r.started_at) AS run_at
  FROM ev
  JOIN run_record r
    ON r.valid AND r.distance_meters >= CAST(ev.cfg ->> 'minDistanceMeters' AS bigint)
   AND r.started_at BETWEEN ev.starts_at AND ev.ends_at
  WHERE ev.kind = 'RUN_DISTANCE'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
entrant AS (
  -- 탈퇴 회원 제외(MemberQueryService.activeNicknames: ACTIVE이고 닉네임이 있는 회원만)
  SELECT x.event_id, x.member_id, m.nickname, x.items, x.first_at
  FROM (SELECT event_id, member_id, count(*) AS items, min(won_at) AS first_at FROM coach_win GROUP BY 1, 2
        UNION ALL
        SELECT event_id, member_id, 1, run_at FROM run_first) x
  JOIN member m ON m.id = x.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.nickname IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ev.title AS "이벤트",
       en.nickname AS "닉네임",
       en.items AS "달성 항목",
       to_char(en.first_at - make_interval(hours => cfg.shift_hours), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "첫 응모 시각"
FROM entrant en
JOIN ev ON ev.id = en.event_id
CROSS JOIN cfg
ORDER BY ev.sort_order, ev.id, en.first_at, en.member_id
LIMIT 2000
